metadata.name: Advanced Elicitation Techniques
metadata.description: Challenge the LLM to produce better results through structured questioning

task.objective: Use advanced elicitation techniques to extract deeper insights, challenge assumptions, and generate more comprehensive responses from the AI.

technique.name: Five Whys
technique.description: Ask "why" five times to get to the root cause of a problem or requirement
technique.example: User states a requirement → Why? → Why? → Why? → Why? → Why? → Root cause revealed

technique.name: Inversion Thinking
technique.description: Instead of asking what to do, ask what NOT to do or what would cause failure
technique.example: Instead of "How do we make this successful?" ask "What would guarantee this fails?"

technique.name: Devil's Advocate
technique.description: Challenge every assumption and proposed solution

prompts.prompt: What's the weakest point in this approach?
What assumptions are we making that might be wrong?

technique.name: Constraint Removal
technique.description: Temporarily remove all constraints to explore ideal solutions
technique.example: "If you had unlimited time, budget, and resources, what would the perfect solution look like?"

technique.name: Perspective Shifting
technique.description: View the problem from multiple stakeholder perspectives

technique.name: Forced Prioritization
technique.description: Force ranking when everything seems equally important

prompts.prompt: If you could only implement ONE feature, which would it be?
What's the absolute minimum viable solution?
Which requirement, if removed, would invalidate the entire project?

technique.name: Analogies and Metaphors
technique.description: Use comparisons to clarify complex concepts
technique.example: "Describe this system as if it were a restaurant kitchen - who are the chefs, what are the recipes?"

technique.name: Pre-mortem Analysis
technique.description: Imagine the project has failed and work backwards
technique.prompt: "It's 6 months from now. The project failed spectacularly. What went wrong?"

usage_guidelines.guideline: Use these techniques when requirements are vague or incomplete
Apply when you sense the AI is giving surface-level responses
Combine multiple techniques for deeper insights
Don't accept the first answer - challenge and probe
Document the insights gained through elicitation

example_session.step: User: "We need a user authentication system"
Agent: "Why do we need authentication?" (Five Whys)
Agent: "What would cause this authentication to fail catastrophically?" (Devil's Advocate)
Agent: "If you had unlimited resources, what would perfect authentication look like?" (Constraint Removal)
Result: Deeper understanding reveals need for 2FA, password policies, and audit logging
